Crypt Ghoul (CV 18)

A gaunt, corpse-eating undead with stretched lips, long nails and flesh drawn tight over its joints. It retains enough cunning to seek an isolated victim and avoid a determined group.

HP: 18 · Speed: Ground 7 · Footprint: 1x1

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: 1 Boon. · Stability: 0.

DR / resistance: None · Condition immunities: Poisoned; Asleep

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body. Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

Against offensive healing: controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: None

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +1; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge -1; Reason +1

Eligibility: Undead 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

Carrying: up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

Lifeless Body — Passive: does not breathe or eat; only listed immunities apply.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
Raking clawsBrawn1 Boon3 physical damage.4 physical damage. Bleeding 1.6 physical damage. Bleeding 2.
Grave touchBrawn1 Boon2 cold damage.3 cold damage.4 cold damage. Paralyzed 1; cannot use this attack next turn.

Raking claws: One adjacent creature.

Grave touch: One adjacent creature. Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

Maneuvers

Shambling Advance — Maneuver

The corpse lurches after the nearest warm body, dragging its ruined feet without ever looking away.

Move up to 2 squares toward a visible living creature within 6 squares; its next attack against that creature before the end of the controller’s turn gains 1 Boon. It must end closer to that creature than it began. For this movement only, treat difficult ground as normal; pay other costs and provoke normally. One attack only; repeated uses do not stack. This grants no attack and cannot be used while movement is prevented.

Use only as part of a command; no independent activity.

Rattle of the Grave — Maneuver

A dry sound rises from the corpse, like someone knocking from inside a coffin.

One creature within 2 squares that can hear it gains Frightened 1 of this summoned form. Once per controller turn; no damage. Frightened applies only while the form is perceptible.

Use only as part of a command; no independent activity.

Defend — Maneuver: gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: 1 Boon to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.
